spans.text: Chotki is an independent project. It is not affiliated with or sanctioned by any church authority. The intention is to give new and existing Christians a way to build an initial daily routine in an Orthodox context.
All content contained in this app is gathered from the public domain. Prayers, readings, and disciplines vary from church to church. Chotki is not a substitute for a priest or spiritual father.
Chotki is best used in cooperation with a spiritual father, and we encourage you to find one as soon as possible.
